added: Experimental: calling cards set the figures apart as Yona Appletree's Contra Card does — the move in bold dark red, the dancers in bold, and amounts such as ½ or 3 places in blue-grey, in your dialect's words. The default card layout does this; add highlight to the figures line of a layout of your own to have it there.
FigureRenderer.dancerTerms: the forms the renderer prints for every dancer and role token under a dialect, for display that sets dancers apart in a rendered line.
